text:
alex: Heads-up — procurement ETA for H100 nodes slipped ~2w. Shipment now estimated 2026-04-01. We need to update capacity reservations and canary plan. Who can recalc reservation windows and adjust autoscale policy? cc @maria @devin
maria: I'm on it. Can you paste the PO/ETA link? Also need to know which customer reservations are affected.
alex: PO #4729: https://vendor.co/ship/4729 — expects container-level delivery 2026-04-01. Affected: dedicated-pool-gold, dedicated-pool-neutral
devin: I'll run a quick impact calc. If we shift 10% of burst to hosted fallback, latency SLOs hold for ~48h for most tiers; heavy tail might see +30ms.
sarah: For the canary schedule, suggest we delay the staged rollouts by one week and increase fallback pool to 15%. That buys time and keeps SLAs.
infra-bot: [automated] capacity-reservation-check: queued=6, reserved=112, available=8
maria: Devin, can you paste the command you used? I want to reproduce the numbers.
devin: Command I ran:
```
python tools/capacity/calc_impact.py --po 4729 --shift 0.10 --out report/4729-impact.md
```
Report uploaded to artifact storage: /reports/4729-impact.md
alex: Thx. Also need an owner to update the infra config in repo: infra/capacity/policies/dedicated.yaml — @sarah volunteer?
sarah: I can do a PR today. Will add a temporary policy override and note the rollback condition. Proposed snippet below:
```
reserved: 0.85
burst_fallback: 0.15
canary_delay_days: 7
```
maria: FYI security needs flagging for Private deployments that expected dedicated hardware in April — may need updated attestation windows.
ops-oncall: If we need to shift live traffic, I'll coordinate DNS/proxy cutovers and firewall rules. Ping me when PR merges and we have a target window.
alex: Let's aim to merge by EOD. If procurement slips further, we'll trigger plan B: onboard extra g4s capacity in us-west for low-priority background inference. :warning:
maria: Adding action items:
- dev: run impact calc and attach report
- sarah: PR with temp policy
- ops: stand by for cutover
- alex: notify sales/customers for impacted reservations
devin: report uploaded: /reports/4729-impact.md (contains per-customer degrade matrix + ETA sensitivity)
sarah: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/894 — reviewers @maria @alex
maria: +1, left one comment about quantization fallback for g4s — small perf note
alex: I'll coordinate customer comms and update the capacity dashboard. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
